title: Busiris
summary: Raleigh names Busiris in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Busiris or Orus the second, the king he says first oppressed Israel. Kept apart from Orus the son of Osiris. The table prints An. Mundi 2438. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: Calculated from printed figures. No tier 1–4 birth, no tier reign start, and no provisional year. Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 2438. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 2438 = 1595 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad. A printed year for this person would replace it.

reign.date: Busiris himselfe reigned 30. yeeres, according to Eusebius
